title: Agent Skills Manifest
description: Selection schema for the current legacy runtime, not the corrected product contract. User clarification 2026-10-10: sets are mutually exclusive root replacements; packs compose by adding per-skill links to an existing canonical .agents/skills/ root. Validation constraints below still encode reversed behavior pending runtime/schema migration. Definitions belong to all-skills/; sets and packs contain references only.

skillName.description: One canonical all-skills/ name: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, or underscore, beginning and ending with a letter or digit.

compositionName.description: One safe set or pack directory name, preserving the case of existing compositions.

versionComponent.description: One safe pack version directory name, including semantic-version prerelease and build suffixes.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference. Validation always uses the schema shipped with the installed Skillex package.

scope.description: Advisory label. Manifest placement determines scope; a mismatch is reported without changing that placement.

inherit_global.description: Legacy runtime: include global selections in a composed project selection; ignored globally or with its exclusive-pack mode. This does not choose write scopes. Exclusive-pack behavior is drift from the 2026-10-10 contract; intended inheritance interaction remains to be specified.

registry.description: Repository identity used to locate an existing local registry cache. It never triggers cloning, fetching, or network access.

skills.description: Explicit canonical all-skills/ references. Legacy runtime applies them after inheritance and ordered additive sets, collapses repeated references, and rejects conflicting targets. Additive-set behavior is drift from the 2026-10-10 mutually exclusive root-replacement contract.

sets.description: Intended contract: sets are mutually exclusive; selecting one replaces .agents/skills/ with a symlink to the set's skill root. Legacy validation/resolution still permits ordered additive sets. That behavior is incorrect and is retained here only until runtime and schema are migrated together.

include.description: Legacy additive-set filter: limit a contribution to these members; omission includes all and an empty list includes none. This does not establish filtering semantics for the corrected root-replacement set model.

exclude.description: Legacy additive-set filter removing members from a contribution. Do not infer permission to mutate a shared set or filter a root alias under the corrected model.

optional.description: Report an unavailable set as an optional skip instead of a required-reference failure.

packs.description: Intended contract: packs are composable and add individual member symlinks to an existing canonical root. Legacy maxItems: 1 and exclusive whole-root replacement are incorrect implementation constraints pending runtime/schema migration, not the meaning of a pack.

anyOf.description: Pack name, optionally followed by @VERSION. An omitted version selects the latest available local version.

optional.description: Legacy runtime reports an unavailable pack as an optional skip and leaves ordinary selections dormant. Dormant exclusive-pack selection is implementation drift, not the intended additive pack contract.

exclude.description: Legacy runtime masks names after inheritance, additive sets, and explicit skills; it ignores exclusions in exclusive-pack mode. Those set/pack semantics are reversed; the corrected model does not yet specify exclusion precedence.
